replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
Hi Adam,

I understand that this appeal has been escalated and that is your wish. However, I just want to point out that most of the people who voted to ban you are not Apollo players. Accusing us of bias and corruption when all we did is review the evidence presented is not only unfair, it's also rather pointless.

Kind regards,
Myworld.

P.S. Sorry, Micah.

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hi,
Since the appeal has been escalated, I will offer a vote within the Senior Staff team where we will discuss your ban. If the vote is in your favor, we will appeal your infraction. If it is not, we will present our argument against you, and you can make rebuttals countering our decision. However, if we see that you are at any point unable to explain or negate our arguments sufficiently, we possess the option to deny and lock the appeal.

Thanks,
rinn
